description: Hooks of this agent: aos functions run when an event happens (before_queue, after_queue, before_tool, after_tool, brain_failed, tool_added, after_start, after_stop, clock_due); the stack copy of this file overrides it by name, null turns one off. The timer hook is a place to hang something every 5 minutes (clock_due, every_ms 300000, AOS_CLOCK); its handler does nothing.
